MethylPhylo Studio 0.3

Research workbench

Analyse DNA alignments, SNPs, methylation matrices and counts using 17 model/method presets. Export trees, simulations and reproducible comparisons.

Run on your computer

git clone https://github.com/Sanjeevan-informatik/methylation-to-phylogenetic-tree.git
cd methylation-to-phylogenetic-tree
python -m venv .venv
# Activate .venv for your operating system
pip install -e .
methylphylo-research serve

Then open http://127.0.0.1:8765. Install IQ-TREE separately for maximum-likelihood models.

The research interface requires the Python backend. This static website runs the original beta-value explorer.
